text:
maya singh: FYI — NovaCore sent an NDA + draft distribution terms for jointly listing their open 13B model on CloudHub. Need quick partnership + legal triage before we reply.

anita roberts: pinging @chris park and @carl ng. what's the redline we should be scanning for redistribution? :mag_right:

chris park: early read — watch for any clause that restricts serving via third-party marketplaces or requires revenue share on downstream customers. also check export/geoblock obligations.

carl ng: from infra perspective, we need explicit permission for quantized redistributions and for providing model artifacts in a dedicated package. otherwise we can only serve behind our runtime (no weights redistribution).

anita roberts: good. NovaCore's draft mentions "distribution to partners" but vague. they also include a 30% rev-share for marketplace SKUs unless we handle inference hosting only.

liz chen: product question — do we want to list as "hosted-only" SKU initially? that avoids weight transfer and simplifies compliance. marketing can still co-announce.

maya singh: proposal: ask for hosted-only listing + exclusive co-marketing window (2 weeks) + optional later marketplace bundle if T&C clarified. call out quantization permission separately. thoughts? :thinking_face:

chris park: I can draft NDA response with two redlines: 1) explicit prohibition on transferring model weights to third parties unless written consent; 2) carve-out permitting runtime-serving + model-quantization for performance testing. Also add standard export control clause and geoblocking by region.

anita roberts: add a clause about attribution & model provenance badge on listing page. NovaCore wanted permissive branding but we should require a joint badge and link to their model card.

carl ng: for the later bundle path, we need a license grant that allows us to create quantized builds and host them in a restricted marketplace artifact repo (S3 w/ ACLs) — or we don't touch weights. even hosted-only requires telemetry terms (latency / usage metrics).

liz chen: timeline: legal reply by EOD tomorrow, partnerships + product sync Wednesday to finalize launch cadence, and engineering to estimate integration work by Friday. can everyone confirm availability?

maya singh: I'm available for Wed sync 10am PT. @chris park, can you have a draft redline by 5pm tomorrow?

chris park: yes, will share a redline PDF + summarized bullets in this thread by 17:00 PT.

partner-bot: NovaCore NDA v0.9 received (attached). Reminder: autogenerated compliance checklist pending.

anita roberts: awesome — I'll coordinate a short pre-read pack for the Wednesday sync (aiming for 10 slides: rights, revshare, launch assets, compliance gaps).

maya singh: thanks all. next steps recap: chris redline by 5pm, carl to sketch hosting vs artifact gating implications, liz to confirm hosted-only launch spec, anita to prep pre-read. i'll reply to NovaCore with a short delay note once redline is ready. :white_check_mark:

carl ng: quick note — if we permit quantized artifacts later, we should require an escrow for provenance and a signed addendum for redistribution scope. will draft tech bullet points.

anita roberts: adding that to the pre-read. if anyone wants to add quick bullets, drop them here.

maya singh: dropping a short sample clause for the reply (feel free to edit):
```
Hosting-only listing: Provider (Redwood) may host and serve Model through Redwood's runtime and Marketplace listing. Provider shall not redistribute or publish Model weights, derivative weights, or model export artifacts to third parties without explicit written consent from Model Owner. Quantization and runtime optimization for the sole purpose of inference serving is permitted, subject to notice to Model Owner.
```

anita roberts: clean and actionable. i'll inline that into the pre-read.

chris park: looks good. i'll tighten language around "derivative weights" and add export control reference.

maya singh: perfect. that should keep the launch moving without committing to full redistribution rights. :rocket:
